title:
Abstract type for all cloud orchestration platforms (e.g. ECS, Kubernetes - EKS/AKS, EMR).
Used to start external cloud services (e.g. {@link Jupyter}).
Note: all concrete subtypes of CloudServiceOrchestrator should mix CloudResource. CloudServiceOrchestrator,
however, does not mix CloudResource, since that causes a confusion in inheritance of the CloudResource Config.
name: CloudServiceOrchestrator
